When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead…
My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered…

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”
translations.bsb: “This is blood!” they exclaimed. “The kings have clashed swords and slaughtered one another. Now to the plunder, Moab!”
translations.kjv: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
translations.asv: and they said, This is blood; the kings are surely destroyed, and they have smitten each man his fellow: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
